modules/Grayhills/scr/00622Read_Story_of: If the quest “King Praetor wants you to find his daughter.” was “achieved”, stop the script (the game then reacts normally). Otherwise, for the player, mark it as “achieved”, then the triggerer learns rumor 1001 “There are thieves on the northern outskirts of Black Root.”, and then stop the script (the game then reacts normally).
modules/Grayhills/scr/00623Pollock_Axe_D:
Repeat the next lines for every item near this object (up to "end of loop"), one at a time.
If the current one (of the loop) is item with name 2201, hurt the current one (of the loop): 100 points of normal damage that nothing can resist. Then, carry on with the next line.
End of the loop: go back to its start with the next one.
Stop the script (skipping the game's normal reaction).
modules/Grayhills/scr/00999Credits.scr: Add slide 45 to the ending of the game, and then stop the script (the game then reacts normally).
modules/Grayhills/scr/02942Shovel_USE.sc:
If the extra object is item with name 1401, change the picture of the extra object (art number 21), and then make the extra object run script 2943 for its “use” event. Otherwise, go to line 3.
Stop the script (skipping the game's normal reaction).
